Two sets of ten slow repetitions. This frees up the upper back; without it, the shoulder compensates on presses.
Bras tendus sur les côtés, dix cercles v: Arms straight out to the sides, ten circles forward then ten backward, increasing the range on each turn.
Deux séries de quinze, avec une charge d: Two sets of fifteen with a tiny load. It wakes up the rear delts before loading the presses.
Deux séries de dix, en descendant lentem: Two sets of ten, lowering slowly. Warms up the chest and triceps.
Deux fois trente secondes. Verrouille le: Twice thirty seconds. Locks in the trunk before moving on to the weights.
Vélo ou marche rapide en côte. L'objecti: Bike or brisk uphill walk. The goal is to raise your temperature, not to tire your legs.
Deux fois quarante-cinq secondes de chaq: Twice forty-five seconds on each side. Tight hip flexors are the most common reason a squat won't go deep.
Genou fléchi vers l'avant, pied à plat,: Knee bent forward, foot flat, ten slow pushes per leg against a wall. This decides how well your heels stay on the floor.
Deux séries de quinze au sol, en marquan: Two sets of fifteen on the floor, holding one second at the top. Wakes up the glutes, which often stay asleep from sitting.
Deux séries de dix, en descendant plus b: Two sets of ten, going lower than with weight. Set the range of motion before adding kilos.
Allure facile, juste de quoi élever la t: Easy pace, just enough to raise your temperature.
Une série lente, sur le haut du dos et l: One slow set for the upper back and hips.
Quelques répétitions à vide du premier m: A few unloaded reps of the workout's first movement.
Dans les deux heures qui suivent, vise u: Within the next two hours, aim for a real meal rather than a snack. The magic thirty-minute window is a myth: it's the daily total that counts.
Prendre du muscle demande de manger un p: Building muscle requires eating a little more than you burn. If the scale doesn't move at all over three weeks, look there before changing the program.
Environ la taille de ta paume : blanc de: About the size of your palm: chicken breast, fish, eggs, cottage cheese, or lentils with rice.
Riz, pâtes, pommes de terre, pain comple: Rice, pasta, potatoes, wholegrain bread. They refill the muscle's energy and make the next workout possible.
Banane, pomme ou fruits rouges, pour les: Banana, apple or berries, for micronutrients and quick sugar.
Un demi-litre au minimum, davantage si t: Half a litre at least, more if you sweated a lot.
Les séances lourdes coûtent plus au syst: Heavy sessions cost the nervous system more than the muscle. Recovery happens as much in your sleep as on your plate.
Le sommeil pèse plus lourd que n'importe: Sleep matters more than any snack for getting stronger. Seven to nine hours, as much as possible.
Environ la taille de ta paume : steak ha: About the size of your palm: minced beef, chicken thigh, tuna, two or three eggs, cottage cheese or tofu. At every meal of the day rather than all at once.
Riz, semoule, pâtes, pommes de terre, pa: Rice, couscous, pasta, potatoes, bread. Don't cut them on heavy days: they fuel short, intense sets.
Une séance longue fait perdre beaucoup d: A long session loses a lot of sodium. A normally salted meal is enough to make up for it.

L'objectif est de garder ton muscle pend: The goal is to keep your muscle while you lose fat. Protein becomes the priority, and food volume helps you not feel hungry.
Perdre plus de cinq cents grammes par se: Losing more than five hundred grams a week usually costs muscle along with fat. Slower is safer.
Blanc de poulet, dinde, poisson blanc, c: Chicken breast, turkey, white fish, shrimp, eggs, fat-free cottage cheese, skyr, or lentils and chickpeas. It protects your muscle in a deficit: prioritise it over everything else.
Courgette, brocoli, haricots verts, chou: Courgette, broccoli, green beans, cabbage, salad, peppers, mushrooms. They fill your stomach for very few calories, which makes the deficit sustainable.
Pas de suppression, mais une portion plu: Don't cut them out, just a smaller portion: a handful of rice, a slice of wholegrain bread or a medium potato.
La sensation de faim est souvent de la s: Feeling hungry is often thirst in disguise.
Rien de particulier à prévoir. Ton proch: Nothing special to plan. Your next normal meal does the job very well.
L'entretien ne demande aucune stratégie: Maintenance doesn't call for any eating strategy. Regular workouts do all the work.

Riz, pâtes, pommes de terre, pain, semou: Rice, pasta, potatoes, bread, couscous. It restores the muscle's energy for the next workout.
